content.description: Cenoa is a borderless super-wallet that gives people in Turkey and other emerging markets access to digital dollars as a bank alternative. Through a non-custodial blockchain wallet, users can convert local currency into the USDC stablecoin, save and earn yield on dollar balances, and send or receive stablecoin payments across borders. Cenoa supports receiving USDC and USDT over networks including Ethereum and Polygon, letting users move value globally at low cost while holding a stable store of value against local currency depreciation. Designed for consumers rather than crypto traders, Cenoa hides blockchain complexity behind a simple savings-and-spending experience aimed at protecting and growing everyday money.
content.meta: Cenoa is a non-custodial super-wallet for digital dollar savings in emerging markets. Discover Cenoa and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
